regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure (Banks rank 1, Pharma/CXO rank 2, both crowded and eligible) over a mean-reverting tape where the absolute-trend gate has no drawdown edge (gate_helps=false) and cross-sectional momentum is a focus lens only. Only 18% of themes are eligible, no single narrative dominates, and the validated edge is absent on this market's history — so this note leans very low, mostly avoid.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the narrow leadership broadens: if eligible count moves from 4 toward 8+ and the Banks/Pharma margin stays razor-thin (0.01), that would mark a confirmed handoff signal worth re-reading; I retire this watch if the eligible fraction falls back below 0.18 or one leader re-asserts dominance with margin >0.05.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is non-eligible under the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false) and shows very low breadth (0.059) despite a 'trend' hurst tag — a narrow, fragile advance. On a mean-reverting tape where the gate itself has no validated drawdown edge (backtest_verdict.absolute_trend_gate: did_NOT_hold_here), the lack of trend-gate eligibility plus extremely thin participation argues against being overweight while not warranting an outright short. Treat as a defensive lean to sit out rather than a fade.
evidence: cross-sectional rank-IC weak — rank 3 is a focus tag, not alpha
theses.dissent: A 'trend' hurst tag with thin breadth can precede a sharp liquidity-driven squeeze; being underweight risks missing a fast move if a single policy or capex catalyst re-rates the theme.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics proxy (515000.SS) closes above its 20-day high while breadth doubles to at least 0.12 before the 20-day check

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the rank-1 leader with high durability (0.73) and broad participation (0.889), but it is crowded (z=1.78, crowded=true) and this market's trend gate has no validated edge. Crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade — and with no validated drawdown discipline on this tape, adding at a crowded leader is not supported by the detector. The lean here is to avoid initiating, not to short or fade the dominant theme.
theses.dissent: High durability and breadth with a mixed hurst tag suggests the trend is broad and coherent; crowding has repeatedly failed to mark tops in reflexive tapes (guardrail do_not_conclude explicitly warns against fading the leader).

falsifier.text: Banks proxy (512800.SS) closes above a fresh 10-day high AND crowding_z normalizes below 1.0 before the 20-day check

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
